site_ui.lead: Build a premium-access brokerage around live events, Super Bowl demand, and VIP buyers—with verified inventory, disciplined pricing, and reliable fulfillment.
site_ui.summary: Multi-exchange POS resale distributes verified ticket inventory through a synchronized point-of-sale system, while stadium suite seat-splitting sells individual places in suites only where contracts and venue rules permit. Super Bowl and tentpole hospitality bundling combines transferable tickets with separately contracted amenities, requiring clear inclusions, supplier verification, and pricing that covers fees, fulfillment, and cancellation exposure.
flow: Choose an event, buyer segment, and model: POS resale, permitted suite seat-splitting, or hospitality bundling.
Confirm supplier identity, inventory rights, transfer timing, resale restrictions, and any suite or hospitality permissions.
Set acquisition limits using net proceeds after fees, amenities, taxes, fulfillment costs, and downside reserves.
Publish accurate listings or buyer proposals with explicit seat details, inclusions, exclusions, and delivery terms.
Synchronize inventory to prevent double-selling, complete authorized transfers, and confirm each hospitality component.
Resolve delivery issues, reconcile payouts and supplier bills, measure realized margin, and cultivate repeat buyers.
